verification_pass_addenda.note: impacts surfaced by the 2026-08-18 verification pass (defects found + fixed; see SEVEN_NEW_CONCEPTS_FINDINGS.md)
wiring_impacts: virtualization window must expose padBottom to the pad height computation — 13 windowed sites shared one bug class; the Slint port should make scroll-extent derivation structural, not hand-computed per list
nav redirects inside a render pass must replace the current stack entry, not push — push-redirects create back-stack loops (c07)
search deep-link landing needs an explicit scroll-to-row step before selection when the target lives outside the rendered window (virtualized lists)
test_fixture_impacts: virtualization full-range probe (single programmatic jump to scrollHeight) belongs in the standard suite — the padBottom bug class was invisible to manual-scroll testing
back-stack integrity probe: deep-link landing then Back must return to the pre-landing view with query/result restored
dispatcher smoke for every rail/index destination (the c05 all-index TypeError survived because the crash left stale-but-alive DOM)
dry_component_impacts: the calm-highlight persistence pattern (state.calmRow re-applied after virtualized redraw, 700ms window, tabindex on rows) is a shared-candidate across all virtualized tables
